result.stdout:
Usage: neoastra [options] <command>
NeoAstra tooling (no telemetry)

Options:
  -h, -?, --help             Show this message and exit

Commands:
  inspect                    Print the resolved project configuration with
                               secrets redacted.
  doctor                     Check the configured toolchain and project policy.
  init                       Create a validated neoastra.json without
                               destructive rewriting.
  dev                        Restore dependencies and coordinate frontend and
                               backend development.
  assets                     Build or validate production frontend assets.
  frontend                   Manage locked frontend dependencies and build
                               fingerprints.
  contract                   Validate generated frontend/backend RPC contracts.
  bundle                     Create an inspectable platform bundle.
  capabilities               Resolve a platform capability manifest.

      --config=FILE          Destination FILE (default: neoastra.json).
      --frontend-root=DIRECTORY
                             Frontend root DIRECTORY.
      --dev-command=ARGUMENT Development command argument; repeat for each
                               ARGUMENT.
      --dev-url=URL          Exact loopback development URL.
      --build-command=ARGUMENT
                             Production command argument; repeat for each
                               ARGUMENT.
      --dist=DIRECTORY       Frontend output DIRECTORY.
      --identifier=IDENTIFIER
                             Stable application IDENTIFIER.
      --display-name=NAME    Application display NAME.
      --package-manager=MANAGER

      --package-manager-command=ARGUMENT
                             Package-manager command prefix; repeat for each
                               ARGUMENT.
      --dry-run              Print the validated configuration without writing
                               it.
      --force                Replace the destination after creating a non-
                               overwriting backup.
